title: Crispy Fried Fish Tacos
description: A twist on traditional fish tacos, topped with crispy fried fish, herbs and a hint of Vietnamese flavor.
instructions: 1. Cut the fish fillets into small pieces and season with salt and pepper.
2. Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
3. Fry the fish pieces until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
4. Drain the fried fish on paper towels.
5. Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
6. Assemble the tacos by placing a few pieces of fried fish onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of Vietnamese chili sauce and a sprinkle of herbs.
7. Serve immediately and garnish with fried onions if desired.
8. Squeeze a sliver of lime juice over the top for added flavor.
